name: Outliner
description: Outline user-described MLIL patterns (inlined functions) into calls with a given signature.
longdescription: Registers a function-workflow activity that matches user-provided MLIL patterns and replaces each match with a call to a function of a user-provided signature. Patterns may carry optional type constraints so outlining only happens when the types match.
